newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling amid weak sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling amid weak sentiment.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) were expected to slip in early trade as weak sentiment cast a gloom over the market, brokers said.
Protests by small investors, angry over the steep decline in share prices, were expected outside the bourse for the second straight day, further unnerving the market, brokers said.

"The share prices may fall because the investors are reluctant to make commitments in a falling market. Institutional investors are also unlikely to support the market at this stage," said broker Sabbir Ahmed. The DSE index closed 60.32 points or 6.28 percent down at 899.38 on Monday.
